title: Database Transactions
description: Implement atomic fund transfers with SQLite transactions, handling success, insufficient funds, and rollback scenarios.

steps.title: Transfer endpoint
steps.description: Create a POST /transfer endpoint that accepts from_id, to_id, and amount, performs an atomic transfer using a database transaction, and returns 201 on success.
hints: Check sender has sufficient balance first

steps.title: Verify balances after transfer
steps.description: Implement GET /balance/:id that returns account details. Verify sender's balance decreased and receiver's increased after a transfer.

steps.title: Atomic failure on insufficient funds
steps.description: When a transfer exceeds sender's balance, return 400 and verify NO balances changed. Tests: failed transfer, then check balances unchanged.

steps.title: Rollback on error
steps.description: If any error occurs (invalid account, server error), ensure the transaction rolls back fully. Verify no partial updates persist after failed transfers.
hints: Wrap transfer in try-catch with rollback
Validate both accounts exist before transferring
